name: Data.exists_isTameFor_costsSquares_one
summary: Tameness from the weights (`isTameFor_of_hasWeight`); the cost from the height bound of the ratios of a fit family and `Data.Pair.lValueProd_eq`.

steps.claim: (1) follows from `isTameFor_of_hasWeight` for the product character (ν·ϑ^n, of the weights of p, with tame part ramified exactly at the places of 𝔪) and inversion. (2): for a fit family θ, the family |c(θ(ι))/c(1)|⁻² is, by `Data.Pair.lValueProd_eq`, levelNorm(θ(ι))^{−z²} times the product over 1 ≤ z′ ≤ z of the squared inverse ratios of the lowered pairs, each of height ≤ x^999 (`IsFitFamily.height_le`); the product has height at most z·2x^999 ≤ 2t·x^999 (z ≤ t), and `Data.IsFitFamily.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul` absorbs the power of the norm.
steps.lean:
D.CostsSquares 1 c := ⟨fun ϑ ↦ by simpa [Pi.neg_def] using! (isTameFor_of_hasWeight
  _ (p.hasWeight.mul (ϑ.powTwist n).hasWeight) r).inv, fun h θ o ↦ o.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul
  (.prod (s := Icc 1 p.z) fun _ _ ↦ (o.height_le n (p.lowerPoint _) 1 r).pow 2) (by simp [field,
  p.7.2]) fun ι _ ↦ ⟨-p.z ^ 2, have := p.lValueProd_eq 1 ((θ ι).powTwist n)
  by simp_all [div_pow, twist_one_spec, MFoldTwist.powTwist, TameChar.pow, places_modulus_eq_union]
     simp_all [field, sq, zpow_mul, pow_mul]⟩⟩
